property_summary: For any deposit amounts d (attacker) and e (other user) with e>=d, a re-entrant withdrawer can never receive more ether than its own credit d; the mutant zeroes credit after the external call, so the re-entrant attacker withdraws twice and receives 2d > d.
change_summary: Move `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` to after the external call, introducing a reentrancy window (checks-effects-interactions violation).
